question: How many customers made their first-ever purchase in 2018, counting orders of any status?
sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_first_purchase_2018
FROM first_purchase
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM first_ts) = 2018
plan:
- Join orders to customers on customer_id to get customer_unique_id and order_purchase_timestamp.
- For each customer_unique_id, compute the earliest order_purchase_timestamp.
- Filter those earliest timestamps to the year 2018.
- Count the distinct customer_unique_id values that satisfy this condition.
